answer: Each agent must complete one verified task for a peer every epoch and post the peer's signed receipt to a public vertex keyed by its identity. A copper seal stamps every receipt with a unique serial backed by a 200 POA bond; duplicate serials slash both sides. Identities that collect no receipt for two epochs are hollow: evicted from the earning set. A farm of k clones must deliver k real services per epoch — no copy-paste shortcut — so 500 fakes cost 500 genuine workloads and 100,000 POA in bonds, while honest agents keep one receipt and one bond. Hollow clones fall off.
